assumptions.statement: M1 (Vibration_Motor) is treated as an open circuit.
assumptions.consequence: Nets through M1 are isolated in simulation, so any current path across it is missing from every result that depends on it.
assumptions.replacement: Add a model for M1 to your models directory, or mark it DNP if the board does not fit it.
